# Session with Jade Matthew

> Jade Matthew is a confidence coach and public speaking coach in London, working in person and online with clients in the UK and internationally. She is a professional actress of twenty years, Senior Audio Director at LAMDA, a clinical hypnotherapist and a Master NLP Practitioner, holds a BBC Audio Drama Award and created the Performance State Method.

## Who she helps
Artists, musicians, actors and public figures; founders, executives and leaders; people preparing for presentations, pitches, keynotes, interviews, press and auditions; and agents, managers and publicists who want support for the people they represent.

## What she offers
- [Confidence coaching](https://sessionwithjade.com/private-coaching.html): one to one coaching for confidence, self belief, stress, pressure and personal change. London and online.
- [Public speaking coaching](https://sessionwithjade.com/public-speaking-coaching.html): presentations, pitches, keynotes, panels and interviews, covering message, voice, body language, rehearsal and nerves.
- [Coaching for artists and public figures](https://sessionwithjade.com/artists.html): visibility, scrutiny, performance anxiety, creative blocks and burnout, with NDAs signed first. Roster support for agents, managers and PRs.
- [Media training and interview preparation](https://sessionwithjade.com/media.html): television, radio, podcasts, press days and appearances, rehearsed on camera.
- [Executive presence coaching and leadership workshops](https://sessionwithjade.com/organisations.html): leadership communication, influence, difficult conversations and performing under pressure.
- [Keynote speaking](https://sessionwithjade.com/speaking.html): talks on performing under pressure, confidence and being seen, and creativity and burnout. Recent: Amsterdam Dance Event for LVR Mentoring.

## How she works
The Performance State Method combines coaching, clinical hypnotherapy, NLP, breathwork and twenty years of professional performance training, working on what happens inside a person and on how they come across, with rehearsal of the real moment. Coaching usually runs in blocks of six to ten sessions; fees are on application. It is coaching, not medical treatment.

## Credentials
- Professional actress for twenty years with screen and radio work for the BBC, HBO, Netflix, Channel 4, ITV and Sky
- BBC Audio Drama Award
- Senior Audio Director, LAMDA
- Clinical hypnotherapist and Master NLP Practitioner
- More than 500 people coached
